faq.title: FAQs
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about our services.

q1.question: What services do you offer?
q1.answer: Custom software development, data integration, business intelligence dashboards, and AI-powered automation — all tailored to your operations.

q2.question: How does your process work?
q2.answer: We start by understanding your business, then move through strategy, development, and deployment — with ongoing support after launch.

q3.question: Can you provide case studies?
q3.answer: Yes — check out our portfolio page, or reach out and we'll share relevant case studies for your industry.

q4.question: What industries do you serve?
q4.answer: Finance, healthcare, retail, technology, and more. If your business runs on data and processes, we can help.

q5.question: How can I contact you?
q5.answer: Fill out the form on our contact page — we'll get back to you within one business day.

simplifyFAQ.title: FAQs
simplifyFAQ.subtitle: Find answers to your questions about our custom development services below.

q1.question: What is custom development?
q1.answer: Software built specifically for your business — designed around your workflows and challenges, not a one-size-fits-all template.

q2.question: How long does it take?
q2.answer: It depends on scope — typically a few weeks to a few months. We'll give you a clear timeline during our initial consultation.

q3.question: What is the cost?
q3.answer: Pricing depends on scope and complexity. We provide a detailed quote after understanding your requirements — no surprises.

q4.question: Can we see examples?
q4.answer: Absolutely. Check out our portfolio, or contact us and we'll share case studies relevant to your industry.

q5.question: How do we start?
q5.answer: Reach out through our contact form. We'll set up a consultation to discuss your needs and next steps.
